newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia says to choose Eurobond manager next week.
newsitem.headline: Russia says to choose Eurobond manager next week.

text.p: The Russian government will choose lead managers for its next Eurobond issue next week, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Friday.
"The work is not over yet," Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasayanov told Reuters. "It will be over next week."
He also said it was premature to say in which currency the next issue would be made.
Other Finance Ministry officials had said previously that the new issue would most likely be denominated in marks.

Russia launched its debut $1.00 billion five-year Eurobond last November. Government officials have said the next issue would be launched in the first quarter of 1997 and that Russia planned to raise a total of $1.5 billion in 1997.
